project: Restoke V2 suppliers migration: foundations and slice 1
description: Close the V2 drift gaps, give people and agents a local loop that matches CI, extend v2:new for list pages, build the two primitives slice 1 needs, then ship th…
objectives: O1 Local = CI: one in-repo command runs exactly the v2-gates checks; local e2e runs with one command.
O2 Drift: every rule the skill calls enforced is enforced by a check, and each failure message tells the reader the fix.
O3 Migration checks: flags know the legacy endpoints they replace; parity checklists are machine-checked.
O4 Generator: v2:new scaffolds a list page with search params and a cutover flag, passing every gate as generated.
O5 Slice 1: /app/suppliers ships behind enableV2SuppliersList with a parity checklist, tests and a browser smoke test.
O6 Simplicity: the smallest code that meets each story; unlikely edge cases are logged, not handled.
outOfScope: Gap 14 (branch protection): a GitHub setting, for a human
Write verbs, tab and dialog page kinds, form/toast/confirm primitives, row selection: slices 2 to 5
Legacy deep-link redirect to V2: needs the detail page (slice 2a)
Pushing, opening PRs, rebasing onto other branches
